title: Contests versus Contracts in Innovation Procurement
abstract: arXiv:2611.31829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How much competition should a designer introduce when procuring innovation? We study a designer funding multiple technological approaches whose feasibility is learned through experimentation. Between independent contracts and contests, we introduce interdependent contracts, which combine approach-specific rewards with continuation decisions that depend on rivals' outcomes. When both breakthroughs and breakdowns are contractable, these contracts implement the optimum by extracting firms' rents and coordinating experimentation across approaches. When only breakthroughs are contractable, we compare simple mechanisms with constant contractual payments. Under technological symmetry, optimal interdependent contracts terminate experimentation at a success cutoff or deadline. translated_title: 创新采购中的竞赛与合同
translated_abstract: 在采购创新时，设计者应该引入多少竞争？我们研究了一个资助多种技术路径的设计者，这些技术路径的可行性需要通过实验来获知。在独立合同与竞赛之间，我们引入了“相互依赖合同”（interdependent contracts），它将针对特定路径的奖励与取决于竞争对手实验结果的继续/终止决策相结合。当突破和失败均可写入合同时，这类合同通过提取企业的租金并协调各路径之间的实验，能够实现最优结果。当只有突破可以写入合同时，我们比较了采用固定合同支付的简单机制。在技术对称的条件下，最优的相互依赖合同会在成功阈值或截止期限处终止实验。固定奖金竞赛可以实现相同的创新结果，但其相对支出取决于实验期限的长短：对于内部成功阈值，竞赛……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“相互依赖合同”这一新机制，通过将路径特定奖励与取决于竞争对手结果的终止决策相结合来研究创新采购的最优设计，证明当突破与失败均可合同化时该机制能实现最优，并在仅突破可合同化时与固定奖金竞赛进行了比较。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "interdependent contracts," which combine approach-specific rewards with rival-dependent continuation decisions in innovation procurement, showing that they implement the optimum when both breakthroughs and breakdowns are contractable, and comparing them with fixed-prize contests when only breakthroughs are contractable.
